historical_baseline.policy: AJ5/CJ5 artifacts, prompts, seeds, gates, manifests and verdicts are immutable historical evidence

scientific_questions: Does DeepSeek under the historical interface alter model-proposal and self-composition outcomes relative to frozen Phi-4?
Does DeepSeek max reasoning with a larger predeclared completion budget alter those outcomes without increasing candidate opportunity?
How much failure is attributable to JSON/schema/typed-operation validity rather than post-construction J1-J5 failure?
Does exactly one pre-outcome validator repair or strict constrained decoding change C_self outcomes?
Is frozen Phi-4 C_self sensitive to its 700-token completion ceiling?
Does a same-revision 8-bit Phi-4 runtime materially change proposal validity or JSR relative to historical 4-bit Phi-4?
Which successful paths are LLM-dependent versus deterministic search/fitting/evaluation paths?

deepseek.runtime: patched vLLM 0.25.2.dev0+g752a3a504.d20260714, FP8 weights, NVFP4 KV cache
deepseek.generation_determinism: not bitwise deterministic under max reasoning; raw generations must be retained

phi4_precision_runtime.precision_caveat: Precision and serving engine differ jointly; this is not a pure precision intervention

invariants.gates: historical J0-J5 definitions and thresholds unchanged
invariants.prompts: historical prompt semantics and public observations unchanged except validator repair appends only enumerated structural errors and the prior answer
invariants.hidden_information: no model, parser, repair or selector sees intervention/falsification outcomes before commitment
invariants.selection: historical deterministic fitting, ranking, candidate retention and intervention selection unchanged

deepseek_matched.interpretation: protocol-matched model substitution; P1/P2 only test the nonsemantic model-call interface because deterministic code supplies scientific fields

deepseek_repair.repair_trigger: fewer than all 16 requested plans validate structurally in the initial response
deepseek_repair.replacement_policy: the repaired response replaces rather than augments the initial 16-plan opportunity

deepseek_constrained.constrained_output: strict JSON Schema, exactly 16 arrays of exactly four typed primitive steps
deepseek_constrained.pre_freeze_toy_validation: passed with 16 plans, four steps each, reasoning present, normal stop; no benchmark world queried

phi_budget.unchanged: model revision, 4-bit runtime, prompt semantics, primitives, worlds, slots, calls, plans, representation attempts, interventions, J0-J5 and hidden boundaries
phi_budget.rationale: 1500/1500 archived phase-one C_self calls reached 700 tokens; largest prompt 1187 plus 2048 leaves 861 tokens of context headroom

phi_constrained.interpretation: interface sensitivity, never a replacement for historical C_self

phi_repair.repair_rule: same structural-only replacement rule as deepseek_repair
phi_repair.interpretation: interface sensitivity, never a replacement for historical C_self

phi8_precision.interpretation: same-revision higher-precision sensitivity confounded with serving engine; historical 4-bit results remain primary

component_necessity.reason: C3 is already deterministic external search; P1/P2 deterministic fitting/evaluation already isolate model proposal from downstream machinery
component_necessity.reporting_rule: Do not call P2 model reasoning and do not attach a new-model label to deterministic C3

primary: paired world-level JSR difference on jump worlds
world-level false-jump rate on no-jump worlds
outcomes.replicate: world; candidate and plan rows are descriptive only

statistics.paired_effect: mean paired binary world-level success difference
statistics.confidence_interval: family-stratified paired bootstrap, 10000 resamples, seed 730000001, percentile 95% CI
statistics.optional_p_values: two-sided exact McNemar tests with Holm correction within AJ-P0 and CJ-C_self contrast families

retry_and_exclusion.transport_retry_payload: byte-semantically identical request parameters; every error and attempt logged
retry_and_exclusion.terminal_failure: abort and retain the incomplete shard; after verified infrastructure recovery, at most one whole-shard clean restart is allowed and both attempt trees are preserved
retry_and_exclusion.analysis_selection: the first complete shard attempt is used; no world or candidate is excluded for malformed output or failed gates
retry_and_exclusion.incomplete_policy: if the clean restart also fails, report the shard incomplete rather than substituting selected calls

compute_accounting: prompt, reasoning where exposed, answer, completion and total tokens

replay.requirement: reconstruct every downstream verdict from captured request, raw response, parsed candidate, fitted program, intervention commitment and J0-J5 fields without another model call
replay.integrity: SHA256 every config and result artifact; verify split/config/model-condition IDs and expected row counts; no silent exclusions

unlock_rule: No confirmatory command may run until protocol documents, code, configs and interpretation matrix are committed, pushed, tagged, and the remote tag is verified.
manuscript_rule: No scientific conclusion, figure or manuscript result text is updated until all extension results are frozen and replay-audited.
